earnings.title: Guardant Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Increases 2026 Revenue Guidance
highlights: Reported total revenue of $361.0 million, an increase of 36%, driven by:
Oncology revenue of $231.3 million, an increase of 25%, and 117,000 oncology tests, an increase of 58%
Biopharma & Data revenue of $59.0 million, an increase of 8%
Screening revenue of $67.6 million, an increase of 180%, and 83,000 Shield tests, an increase of 246%
Third quarter 2026 revenue growth of 36% driven by strong performance in Oncology and Screening

quotes.text: Revenue grew 36% year over year as we continued to execute across Oncology, Screening, and Biopharma.
Shield continued to build momentum in the third quarter, with volume more than tripling year over year to 83,000 tests.

outlook: Raises 2026 revenue guidance to $1.36 to $1.37 billion, representing growth of 38% to 40%
Guardant Health now expects full year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $1.36 to $1.37 billion, representing growth of 38% to 40% compared to full year 2025.
Oncology revenue is expected to grow approximately 30% and Oncology volume is now expected to grow over 50%.
Screening revenue is now expected to be in the range of $233 to $238 million, driven by Shield volume of 285,000 to 290,000 tests.
